claims.scope: For every genuine Boolean disjoint splice F=a+hb and every finite adaptive nonreusing physical restriction tree interleaving source-block and child-block queries, the sum of exact coherent remainders at child queries plus the leaf potential is at most the root potential P=(4+2ln2+2/e)q I(h)+Var(h) E_raw(b), in natural-log units.
hypotheses: the root source block W and child block X are disjoint
a+b and a-b are genuine Boolean signs and h is a genuine Boolean sign
node witnesses are actual coherent restrictions of the one root pair, not arbitrary unrelated arrays
each physical coordinate is queried at most once on a root-leaf path

proof_dependencies.claim: source restriction laws: average q is preserved and average E_raw(b) cannot increase
proof_dependencies.evidence: Parseval plus scalar-kernel nonnegativity; proved in CHANGING_WITNESS_TELESCOPE.tex

proof_dependencies.claim: child restriction laws: I drop is Inf_i and variance drop is alpha_i^2

claims.exact_single_use_identity: sum_X w alpha^2 Z + sum_W w V [Z-E_child Z] + sum_leaf w VZ = Var(h_root) E_raw(b_root)
does_not_prove: a universal influence bound for E_raw(b)

claims.scope: Universal payment of complete biased coherent remainders across arbitrary Boolean hierarchies.
claims.prior_obstruction: node-dependent reverse-collision reserves could be recharged at every node
claims.new_obstruction: coherent source restrictions are now paid once; the remaining universal terms are the root terminal derivative entropy Var(h)E_raw(b) and, for overlapping inputs, the simultaneous-change covariance terms
